[SWS_DM_02104] Provision of DTC number
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04170
⌈
The DM shall provide the DTC number for which the interfaces is triggered within
metaInfo using the Key kDtc in all the subsequently called ara::diag interfaces for the
purpose of extended data and snapshot data collection.
⌋
